sloka: समन्ताद्योजनशतं विषयं चास्य दुर्मतेः ।धक्ष्यते पांसुवर्षेण महता पाकशासनः ।। ७.८१.८ ॥
transliteration: samantādyojanaśataṁ viṣayaṁ cāsya durmateḥ ।dhakṣyate pāṁsuvarṣeṇa mahatā pākaśāsanaḥ ।। 7.81.8 ॥

translations.english: Shukra declares that Indra will destroy the evil-minded Daṇḍa's region, extending a hundred yojanas in all directions, with a mighty shower of dust.
